# SIGNAL ROLES - who may be edited (generated by tools/audit-roles.js, v1.18.x)

Why: in a real plant the operator changes the SV, the manual values and the switches; the PV and the feedbacks are the plant answering. The simulator has no plant, so every field signal is an input. This table classifies EVERY external input of the 51 sheets so that the right method can be chosen (docs/SIMULATION-METHOD.md).

## Counts
| Role | Inputs |
|---|---|
| analog: PV of a loop: simulated by the process model | 22 |
| analog: REVIEW: analog that reaches a controller and is still editable | 27 |
| analog: field measurement or disturbance, not tied to a controller | 107 |
| analog: linked from another sheet (set there) | 1 |
| analog: operator value (COS / SV) | 140 |
| digital: PV of a loop: simulated by the process model | 43 |
| digital: operator switch (COS) | 26 |
| digital: switch / mode / status that reaches a controller | 137 |
| digital: switch / status / DITL signal | 331 |
